Siri AI is the highlight upgrade and key feature of iOS 27 and later versions. However, only newer Apple devices will support the fully revamped Siri. Here's the complete hardware list that supports Siri AI, covering iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

The following are the Apple products that support Siri AI on iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and related updates include the long-awaited major Siri overhaul, named Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on designated hardware (and in specific regions). Here are all the Apple products that support Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models equipped with Apple silicon (M1 chip and later, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (requires pairing with an AI-capable iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later models
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later models
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All the products mentioned above support Siri AI. However, some Siri experiences will perform even better on designated hardware.

For example, the full customization of Siri AI's speaking speed and expressiveness is limited to certain hardware. According to Apple:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models are only available on newer products. Devices equipped with these models may experience faster Siri AI performance, or they may not.

Will Siri AI make you want to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
